source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.7, printed page 309.

blocks.text: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, kai jure hue aromatic halqon se bane, aam maholiyati pollutants hain; naphthalene, anthracene aur phenanthrene misalein hain. Yeh bunyadi taur par fossil fuels (coal, oil, petrol aur lakri) ke na-mukammal jalne, gariyon ke ikhraj aur sanati amal mein, aur yahan tak ke grill kiye khane mein bante hain; kuch qudrati zaraye jaise khule jalne aur petroleum aur coal ke zakhair ke qudrati rasao se aate hain. Yeh mumkina taur par zehreele aur cancer paida karne wale (carcinogenic) hain.

blocks.prompt: PAHs fiza mein kaise dakhil hote hain, aur insani sehat par kaise asar dalte hain (Quick Check 14.2b; exercise Q.2f)?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar engines, sanat aur khule jalne mein coal, oil, petrol aur lakri ke na-mukammal jalne se, thori miqdar petroleum aur coal ke qudrati rasao se. Saans ya khurak se andar ja kar naphthalene aur anthracene jaise PAHs zehreele hain aur kai carcinogenic, phephron aur doosre cancers ka khatra barhate hue.

items: PAHs: jure aromatic halqe (naphthalene, anthracene, phenanthrene) na-mukammal jalne, gariyon, sanat, grill khane, rasao se; zehreele aur carcinogenic.
